1:# Saved destinations
2:
3:Python 3.9+, standard library only. Run `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
4:
5:Destination records can use legacy top-level `address` or current nested
6:`destination.address`. New writes use the nested shape. Background migration
7:runs in bounded batches while reads remain available; a deployment must read
8:both shapes until migration finishes. Existing addresses must be preserved.
9:
10:`data/records.json` is a supported mixed snapshot. `api.list_destinations`
11:serves all saved records through the same reader. `migrate_batch` changes up to
12:its limit per invocation; there is no startup migration gate. The store is a
13:local JSON model, with no production environment or external database required.
